meta.title: Bibliography Builder Accessibility E2E
meta.description: Installs Block Accessibility Checks so the BAC integration assertions in a11y.spec.js actually run instead of skipping.
meta.author: danknauss

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';

foreach ( array( 'bibliography-builder.php', 'block-accessibility-checks.php' ) as $entry ) {
	foreach ( glob( WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/*/' . $entry ) as $candidate ) {
		activate_plugin( plugin_basename( $candidate ) );
		break;
	}
}
